sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Corporate Secrets is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Did it ever occur to you that we are living in unique times? As if any secret can easily be revealed, the camera obscura will open up, all you need to do is put in some effort ... Let me explain, my friend. You have already poked around corporate territories, laboratories, offices, and all else. Those places have already been looted to the ground. But do you know where there still might be something interesting? In the offices of the wastewater treatment plant. Yes, that facility was also under TerraGroup. What do I want to find? Fact is, I don't even know myself yet. To begin with, let's try to find out what exactly TerraGroup was doing there. Contaminated water, chemical dump ten times over normal? Anything can open up. Prepare well - I hear there is unusually high activity in that area. Perhaps someone is guarding the territory against prying eyes."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 17 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find the data on water pump operation
- Hand over the extracted data
- Find the data on pumping station operation
- Hand over the extracted data

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +8,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.02
- 40,000 Roubles
  - 42,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
  - 46,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
- Unlocks purchase of Kalashnikov AK-104 7.62x39 assault rifle (variant RPKT mod.1) at Ref LL2
- Unlocks purchase of DevTac Ronin helmet at Mechanic LL2
"So there were some documents? Give'em to me. Let's see ... Stationery delivery, office rent - nothing interesting so far... There it is, chemicals. The "BLUE ICE" traces in the water? What is this, some kind of refrigerant? Alright, I'll deal with this, but for now, take yourself a small gift for your efforts. Thanks again, friend."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Water pump operation data | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
| Pumping station operation report | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
The wanted documents are located in two different buildings at the water treatment plant in the north of the Lighthouse location.

sections.heading: Pumping station operation report
sections.text: The documents are located on a shelf in the left hand upstairs office of building no. 1 in the west of the plant.

sections.heading: Water pump operation data
sections.text: The documents are located on a desk in the left hand upstairs office of building no. 2 in the north of the plant.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The "Blue Ice" is likely a reference to methamphetamine cooked by Walter White, in the AMC TV series Breaking Bad.
